filer_name.rationale: Form8606IRANamelineTxt corresponds to the 'Your name' field at the top of the form.

filer_ssn.rationale: NondedIRATxpyrWithIRASSN corresponds to the Social Security Number of the IRA owner on the form.

tax_year.rationale: No canonical element for the tax year header field exists in the provided candidate list; this is typically a form-level attribute, not a leaf element in the schema.

part_i_applicable.rationale: No canonical boolean indicator for Part I applicability exists in the candidate list; this is a blueprint-level structural concept not represented as a leaf element.

line_1.rationale: NondedIRACurrTYNondedContriAmt corresponds to Line 1, nondeductible contributions to traditional IRAs for the current tax year.

line_2.rationale: NondedIRABasisForPYAmt corresponds to Line 2, total basis in traditional IRAs as of the end of the prior tax year.

line_3.rationale: NondedIRAPostTaxYrContriAmt corresponds to Line 3, the sum of lines 1 and 2 representing total basis including current-year contributions.

line_4.rationale: NondedIRATotRllvrWthdrwVlAmt corresponds to Line 4, total distributions from traditional/SEP/SIMPLE IRAs including converted amounts.

line_5.rationale: NondedIRAWthdrwLessRllvrAmt corresponds to Line 5, outstanding rollover amounts included in line 4 that are not taxable.

line_6.rationale: NondedIRANotCnvrtLessRllvrAmt corresponds to Line 6, net distributions subject to the basis-recovery calculation (line 4 minus line 5).

line_7.rationale: NondedIRACurrTYIRAPlusRllvrAmt corresponds to Line 7, the combined year-end IRA value plus net distributions used as the denominator.

line_8.rationale: NondedIRATaxYearBasisRt corresponds to Line 8, the nontaxable portion ratio expressed as a decimal.

line_9.rationale: NondedIRANontxOfWthdrwAmt corresponds to Line 9, the nontaxable portion of current-year distributions.

line_10.rationale: NondedIRANontxCnvrtAmt corresponds to Line 10, the nontaxable portion of current-year conversions to Roth IRA.

line_11.rationale: NondedIRANontxWthdrwUncnvrtAmt corresponds to Line 11, total nontaxable distributions (sum of lines 9 and 10).

line_12.rationale: NondedIRATaxableAmt corresponds to Line 12, the taxable portion of traditional IRA distributions.

line_13.rationale: TaxableIRAConversionAmt corresponds to Line 13, the taxable amount of conversions to Roth IRA.

line_14.rationale: NondedIRATaxYearNetBasisAmt corresponds to Line 14, remaining basis in traditional IRAs at year-end carried forward to next year.

part_ii_applicable.rationale: No canonical boolean indicator for Part II applicability exists in the candidate list; this is a blueprint-level structural concept not represented as a leaf element.

line_16.rationale: TotalIRAConvertedToRothAmt corresponds to Line 16, total amount converted from traditional/SEP/SIMPLE IRAs to Roth IRAs.

line_17.rationale: TraditionalIRABasisAmt corresponds to Line 17, basis allocable to the converted amount from the Part I nontaxable portion calculation.

line_18.rationale: TaxableIRADistributionAmt corresponds to Line 18, the taxable amount of the Roth conversion (line 16 minus line 17).

part_iii_applicable.rationale: No canonical boolean indicator for Part III applicability exists in the candidate list; this is a blueprint-level structural concept not represented as a leaf element.

line_19.rationale: TotNonQlfyDistriFromRothIRAAmt corresponds to Line 19, total distributions received from all Roth IRAs during the year.

line_20.rationale: QlfyFirstTimeHmByrExpensesAmt corresponds to Line 20, qualified first-time homebuyer expenses included in Roth IRA distributions.

line_21.rationale: NetQlfyFirstTimeHmByrExpnssAmt corresponds to Line 21, adjusted Roth IRA distribution amount (line 19 minus line 20).

line_22.rationale: ROTHIRAContributionBasisAmt corresponds to Line 22, total basis in Roth IRA regular contributions.

line_23.rationale: DistriRothIRALessBasisCnvrtAmt corresponds to Line 23, distributions in excess of regular Roth contribution basis.

line_24.rationale: BasisInCnvrtQlfyRtrPlanAmt corresponds to Line 24, basis from Roth IRA conversions and rollovers not yet distributed tax-free.

line_25.rationale: NetBasisInRothIRAContriAmt corresponds to Line 25, the taxable amount of Roth IRA distributions (earnings beyond all basis).
